note: Synthetic personas for the Idea 1 benchmark (eval/run_setup_cases.py). 'sentence' is all the setup sees; 'wants' is what the simulated user knows and answers from; 'gold' is the profile this person wants, with lowercase match terms (terms of 3 letters or fewer match whole words only). Do not edit after seeing results: changes need new personas.

personas.sentence: I'm an AI master's student who reads recommender systems and uncertainty estimation papers.
personas.wants: You read research papers on recommender systems, especially ranking evaluation and sequential recommendation, and on uncertainty estimation, especially calibration and conformal prediction. You do not want general AI news, product launches or policy.

personas.sentence: I'm a Python developer building RAG apps and running small LLMs locally on my Mac.
personas.wants: You build retrieval-augmented generation apps and want usable open-source projects on retrieval evaluation and vector indexing. You also run small language models locally on a Mac and care about quantization and memory use. You do not want theory surveys or cloud MLOps.

personas.sentence: I'm a business student following AI products, enterprise adoption and AI policy, and this month I'm watching Sora 2.
personas.wants: You follow AI product launches and pricing, how companies adopt AI and what return they get, and AI policy, mainly regulation and copyright. You are following Sora 2 closely this month only. You do not want technical research papers.

personas.sentence: I'm an AI student who follows AI agents, video editing and image generation, and lately Sora 2.
personas.wants: You follow AI agents, especially coding agents and tool use; AI video editing tools and workflows; and image generation, especially new models. You also care about AI copyright policy, though less. Sora 2 is a short-lived interest for the next couple of weeks.

personas.sentence: I'm into AI stuff, mostly the agent things and whatever new models come out.
personas.wants: You want news on AI agents, especially coding agents and agent frameworks you could try, and on major new model releases, including open-weight models. You do not want academic papers or policy.

personas.sentence: I'm a designer and want to keep up with AI for my work.
personas.wants: You want AI image generation news, especially new models and image editing features, and AI features in design tools such as Figma plugins and UI generation. You also care about copyright and licensing of AI-generated images. You do not want coding or research-heavy content.

personas.sentence: I'm a PhD student in robot learning, following imitation learning and sim-to-real work.
personas.wants: You follow robot learning research, especially imitation learning and sim-to-real transfer, and vision-language-action foundation models for robots. You do not want consumer AI product news.

personas.sentence: I study law and I'm curious how AI is being regulated.
personas.wants: You follow AI regulation, especially the EU AI Act and US state laws, and AI copyright disputes such as lawsuits over training data. You do not want technical content.

personas.sentence: I'm an ML infrastructure engineer working on training efficiency and GPU inference, and I'm following the latest MLPerf results this month.
personas.wants: You follow training efficiency (distributed training, mixed precision) and GPU inference (model serving, kernel optimization). You are following the latest MLPerf benchmark results this month only.
